titles.ja: 天元突破 グレンラガン
titles.th: อภินิหารหุ่นทะลวงสวรรค์ กุเร็นลากันน์
titles.zh-Hant: 天元突破 紅蓮螺巖

title.ja: お前のドリルで天を突け!!
title.en: Pierce the Heavens with Your Drill!
title.de: Durchbrich den Himmel mit deinem Bohrer
title.fr: Transpercer les cieux avec ta vrille !
title.it: Trapassa i cieli con la tua trivella
title.pl: Swoim wiertłem przebij się przez niebiosa!
title.x-jat: Omae no Drill de Ten o Tsuke!!

1.overview: Kamina is jailed for trying to escape to the surface. Suddenly, a mysterious woman named Yoko comes from aboves to the underground village while fighting a giant robot. Simon helps fend off the robot with the help of his new "Gunmen", which he found while drilling around.
1.summary:
Living underground in Giha Village, Simon and Kamina dream of a life on the surface. When their home is invaded from above, it is up to them to activate the mysterious mecha Lagann and save their village.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 俺が乗るって言ってんだ!!
title.en: I Said I`d Ride It
title.de: Ich sagte, ich werde dieses Ding steuern
title.fr: J`ai dit que c`est moi qui le piloterai !!
title.it: Ho detto che lo piloterò io
title.x-jat: Ore ga Noru tte Itten Da!!

2.overview: Now above ground Kamina, Simon and Yoko find themselves faced with 2 more gunmen.  They dispatch these 1 of them with the help of people from Yoko's home of Ritona town. Ritona is soon under attack by 3 more Gunmen, but some quick (and insane) thinking by Kamina saves them...
2.summary:
Now that they`ve made it to the surface, Simon and Kamina must join together with Yoko and her village to defeat the Beastmen pursuing them.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 頭が2つたぁナマイキな!!
title.en: You Two-Faced Son of a Bitch!
title.de: Was glaubst du, wer du bist mit deinen zwei Gesichtern?
title.fr: Arrogant à deux tête !
title.it: Due Belle Facce Toste
title.es: ¿Quién crees que eres, con tus dos caras?
title.ru: Ты кто такой, с двумя рожами?
title.pl: Ty, z dwoma twarzami, nie podskakuj

3.overview:
Simon, Kamina, and Yoko encounter a beastman by the name of Viral while they are hunting.  They get into a fight and learn that his Gunman has 2 faces, the normal Gunman head and another head on top.

He dispatches them at the field, but Viral says he will destroy them at the village tomorrow.  Kamina and Simon have to find a way to beat a person who is a far superior pilot...
3.summary:
Kamina and Simon must work together to defeat a dangerous new Beastman threat.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 顔が多けりゃ偉いのか!?
title.en: Does Having So Many Faces Make You Great?
title.de: Auch mit vielen Gesichtern bist du kein starker Typ
title.fr: C`est pas le nombre de têtes qui compte !
title.it: Tante Facce Non Ti Rendono Migliore
title.es: Tener muchas caras no te hace ser genial
title.x-jat: Kao ga Ookerya Erai no ka!?

4.overview: Leeron finds a return point programmed into Gurren and Kamina, Simon, Yoko and Leeron (now called the Gurren Brigade) go after it.  Kamina tries to train Simon to fuse more "manly" by throwing rocks at him.  They meet the Black siblings, who are after a certain gunmen with 16 faces.
4.summary:
Team Gurren must work together with the eccentric Black Syblings to take down a Beastman foe on empty stomachs.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 俺にはさっぱり判らねえ!
title.en: I Don`t Understand It at All!
title.de: Ich versteh das überhaupt nicht!
title.fr: Sérieux, je pige que dalle a tout ça !
title.it: Proprio Non Riesco a Capire!

5.overview:
The Gurren Brigade falls into an underground village where Gunmen are called Face gods.  They meet a young man by the name of Rossiu and the head priest of the village. The head priest is very strict in the running of his village and Kamina has a big problem with the way things are run.  

Things get a lot worse when another Gunmen falls under ground.
5.summary:
Team Gurren must find their way out of a strange underground village where they worship Gunmen as divine beings.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: てめえら全員湯あたりしやがれ!!
title.en: All of You Bastards Put Us in Hot Water!
title.de: Es gibt ein paar Dinge, die ich unbedingt sehen muß!
title.it: Quel Che Voglio Vedere lo Voglio Vedere
title.es: ¡Siéntate en la bañera caliente hasta que te sientas mal!

6.overview:
After leaving the underground with their new brigade members, Rossiu, Gimmy and Darry, they get back on track to find the return point programmed into the Gurren.  They soon find that the enemy return point is mobile. 

They find themselves in a weird fog and wind up at a hotspring, but there is something fishy about this particular hot spring...

This is also a recap episode.
6.summary:
Continuing to the Gunmen rallying point, Team Gurren finds themselves on a strange hot springs getaway.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: それはお前がやるんだよ!!
title.en: You`ll Be the One To Do That!
title.de: Du wirst es machen!
title.fr: Cette fois, c`est toi qui va te charger du boulot
title.it: Di Questo Te ne Occuperai Tu!
title.x-jat: Sore wa Omae ga Yarunda yo!!

7.overview: Following their ordeal at the hot springs, Viral appears before the Gurren Brigade to challenge Kamina and in the midst of their fight more details of the Beastman Empire are revealed. Just when things couldn't get more out of hand, one of the Four Divine Generals named Thymilph, arrives to support in a massive mobile Gunmen fortress, the Dai-Ganzan. Even the Gurren-Lagann may not stand a chance against this.
7.summary:
Thymilph, one of the Four Divine Generals of the mysterious Spiral King, arrives to support Viral`s Enki, with the massive mobile Gunmen fortress, the Dai-Ganzan. Kamina and Simon pilot the Gurren-Lagann against seemingly overwhelming odds.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: あばよ, ダチ公
title.en: Farewell Comrades!
title.de: Später, Kumpel
title.fr: Adieu mon frère
title.it: Addio, Amici Miei

8.overview:
Kamina, Simon and the rest of the Great Gurren Brigade plan to take down Thymilph, one of the Four Divine Generals of the Spiral King, and his massive mobile Gunmen fortress, the Dai-Ganzan.

Their plan involves having Simon using Lagann to take over the Dai-Ganzan the same way he fuses with the Gurren, but an something unexpected causes a great tragedy in the following battle.
8.summary:
Having temporarily stalled Viral and Thymilph in the last skirmish, the Team Gurren and their newly arrived allies join forces as "Team Dai-Gurren" and launch a decisive strike against the regrouping Gunmen force.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ヒトっていったい何ですか?
title.en: Just What Exactly Is a Human?
title.de: Was genau ist ein Mensch?
title.fr: Qu`est-ce exactement un homme ?
title.it: Che Cosa Significa la Parola "Persona"?

9.overview: The death of Thymilph has brought about the concern of the Spiral King (Lord Genome), meanwhile the Great Gurren Brigade managed to take control of the enemy fortress, but are still mourning other the death of one of their own. Simon is greatly affected by it and falls into a deep depression. After falling off a cliff and into a deep valley, he later notices a Gunman throw a capsule into the murky valley. He manages to open it only to discover a young human girl named Nia.
9.summary:
Team Dai-Gurren is still mourning on Kamina`s death. Simon notices a Gunman throw a capsule into a deep valley. He inspects it and is able to open it, and inside is a human girl named Nia, but their introduction is cut short when an enemy Gunman appears.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: アニキっていったい誰ですか?
title.en: Who Really Was Your Big Brother?
title.de: Wer ist dieser Bruder?
title.fr: C`était quoi comme genre de type, ton frangin ?
title.it: Chi era la persona che chiami "fratello"?

10.overview: Nia true identity is revealed, as she flaunts her authority to get rid of another one of the Four Divine Generals, Adiane. The members of the Great Gurren Brigade are now suspicious of Nia and her true intentions but she is only concerned about the depressed Simon. Adiane later returns to finish them all off, with Lord Genome's blessing.
10.summary:
Having been temporarily spared by Adiane, another of the Four Divine Generals, Team Dai-Gurren uses the reprieve to reassess their situation. Nia learns of Kamina`s significance in Simon`s erratic behavior and offers him some stinging, yet honest advice, which draws the ire of an untrusting Yoko. With tension building within the Team, the crew scrambles to stand by Nia`s side when Adiane returns to complete her stalled attack.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: シモン, 手をどけて
title.en: Simon, Please Remove Your Hand
title.de: Simon, Hände Weg
title.fr: Retire ta main, Simon !
title.it: Simon, togli le mani

11.overview: Following Adiane failed attempt to destroy the Great Gurren Brigade another member of the Four Divine Generals, Guame decides to take it upon himself to take up this task. The Brigade later receives a distress call from a village that is supposedly begin attacked by Ganmen but this is actually a trap laid out by Guame.
11.summary:
Team Dai-Gurren falls into a trap set by the third member of the Four Divine Generals, Guame. The Team is taken captive and stored underground to await execution. While digging an escape path, Simon finally understands Kamina`s last words to him and after having a discussion with Guame, Nia finds out the reason why she was thrown away.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ヨーコさん, お願いがあります
title.en: Youko-san, I Have Something to Ask of You
title.de: Yoko, tust du mir einen Gefallen?
title.fr: Mademoiselle Yoko, j`ai une faveur à vous demander
title.it: Yoko, mi faresti un favore?

12.overview: The Great Gurren Brigade are now on their way to Beastmen's capital city, Teppelin but there's a vast ocean in there way. The only way for them to get across is for the Dai-Gurren to be modified, so while they wait everyone goes to chill out at the beach. Once preparations are complete, the Great Gurren Brigade begins their cruise but there's an ambush waiting for them.
12.summary:
On their way to Teppelin, the Beastmen`s capital city, Team Dai-Gurren stumbles upon a vast ocean and must wait for modifications on the Dai-Gurren to be completed before crossing it. While the rest of the group play at the beach, Yoko starts to feel uneasy about Nia and all the attention she gets from them. After preparations are complete, Team Dai-Gurren begins their sea cruise, oblivious to the fact that an ambush is underway by Adiane and Viral.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: みなさん, たーんと召しあがれ
title.en: Everybody, Eat to Your Heart`s Content
title.de: Aufessen, alle Mann!
title.fr: Bon appétit à tous !
title.it: Ragazzi, mangiate a volontà!

13.overview: With Nia having become more welcome in the Great Gurren Brigade, feels the need to contribute something. She decides to cook for them but just before they could get a taste Cytomander the Swift, the fourth member of the Divine Generals, launches an aerial attack. With Rossiu currently out of commission, Yoko accompanies Simon, on the Gurren-Lagann, to lead the counter-attack.
13.summary:
Trying to do her part in Team Dai-Gurren, Nia decides to become a cook, but just before the crew have a taste of her dishes, Cytomander, the fourth member of the Divine Generals, launches an aerial attack on the Dai-Gurren. Simon leads the counter-attack on the Gurren-Lagann, this time accompanied by Yoko, who replaces a sick Rossiu.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 皆さん, ごきげんよう
title.en: How Are You, Everyone?
title.de: Gut getroffen, Leute
title.fr: Ravie de faire votre connaissance
title.it: Salve, ragazzi

14.overview: One month has past since the battle with Cytomander and Simon and Yoko pay one last visit to Kamina burial site. Because Great Gurren Brigade has arrived at the outskirts of Imperial City Teppelin, meaning it is finally time for the final battle to commence. Nevertheless before they even aim towards the city the must first deal with the combined full-scale attack of Cytomander and Guame's forces.
14.summary:
At last, Team Dai-Gurren arrives at the outskirts of Teppelin, but before aiming to the city, they must face a combined full-scale attack of Cytomander and Guame`s forces.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 私は明日へ向かいます
title.en: I`ll Head Towards Tomorrow
title.de: Ich werde in die Zukunft aufbrechen
title.fr: Je vais affronter mon avenir
title.it: Io andrò incontro al domani!

15.overview: The last of the Divine Generals have fallen and all that stands before the Great Gurren Brigade and victory, is the Imperial City Teppelin. However right before their eyes Teppelin collapses and reveals its true form, as a Gunman of gigantic proportions. Nia request to go along with Simon, in the Gurren-Lagann, to confront her father Lord Genome. First they must penetrate the impregnable defense.
15.summary:
The last of the Divine Generals fall, and the city of Teppelin collapses, revealing a Gunman of gigantic proportions. Simon and Nia struggle to pass through it in order to confront her father, the Spiral King himself.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 総集片
title.en: Summary Episode
title.de: Zusammenfassung
title.fr: Polysynthèse complète
title.it: Episodio riassuntivo

16.overview: A recap of the story's events from the previous episodes.

title.ja: あなたは何も分かってない
title.en: You Understand Nothing
title.de: Du weißt überhaupt nichts
title.fr: Vous n`avez rien compris ou quoi ?
title.it: Tu non capisci proprio nulla!

17.overview: Seven years have past, since the capture of Teppelin and under Simon's leadership, a new capital city has been built from the remnants of the royal capital. As the humans being to prosper and including the lives of those who helped make it all happen. However, these peaceful times come to end when the threat mentioned in Lord Genome's last words starts to reveal itself.
17.summary:
During the following seven years, a new civilization rises and prospers under Simon`s leadership. However, these peaceful times come to end when the threat mentioned in Lordgenome`s last words starts to reveal itself.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 聞かせてもらうぞ この世界の謎を
title.en: I`ll Make You Tell the Truth of the World
title.de: Verrat mir die Geheimnisse dieser Welt
title.fr: Expliquez-moi les énigmes de ce monde
title.it: Svelami i segreti di questo mondo
title.pl: Opowiedz mi o sekretach tego świata
title.x-jat: Kikasete Morauzo Kono Sekai no Nazo o

18.overview: Following the shocking declaration by Nia, everyone is in disarray, especially Simon who can't seem to find her. Rossiu has finally completed his secret project, to awaken Lord Genome in the form of data and learn some of the mysteries of the world.
18.summary:
After the Anti-Spirals` first attack and Nia`s astonishing announcement, Simon looks desperately for her, while Rossiu finally completes his secret project.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 生き残るんだ どんな手段を使っても
title.en: We Must Survive. No Matter What It Takes!
title.de: Wir werden überleben, koste es, was es wolle
title.fr: Nous devons survivre, peu importe les moyens à employer
title.it: Noi tutti sopravviveremo, con ogni mezzo!
title.ru: Мы должны спастись во что бы то ни стало
title.pl: Musimy żyć, bez względu na wszystko
title.x-jat: Ikinokorunda Donna Shudan o Tsukatte mo

19.overview: With news that the moon will fall in 3 weeks known across the city, riots have broken out. So to soothe the public opinion, Rossiu puts Simon him under arrest. Meanwhile Leeron is trying figure out a way to defeat the Mugan without causing so much destruction. Later on Simon is taken to trial but during this the Anti-Spirals launch a large scale attack on Rittona.
19.summary:
To soothe the public opinion, Rossiu overthrows Simon and puts him under arrest. But when the Anti-Spirals launch a large-scale attack on Kamina City, he is left with no option but to let Simon engage the enemy using the Gurren-Lagann, not before resorting to extremes to put him under his control.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 神はどこまで僕らをためす
title.en: Oh God, To How Far Will You Test Us?
title.de: Wie lange will Gott uns noch prüfen?
title.fr: Dieu, jusqu`où irez-vous pour nous tester ?
title.it: Fino a che punto Dio ci metterà alla prova?
title.es: ¿Cuánto más nos pondrá a prueba Dios?
title.ru: Сколько ещё нас ждёт Господних испытаний?
title.pl: Bóg sprawdza nas aż do końca
title.x-jat: Kami wa Doko made Bokura o Tamesu

20.overview: Simon now being branded as a war criminal has been sentenced and what awaits him in prison is none other than Viral, his new cellmate. There's only a little over a week until the moon will crush the Earth and the evacuation to the Arc-Gurren is progressing slowly. However Leeron's shocking simulation, to what will happen when the moon falls, only spells more bad news for humankind.
20.summary:
As Simon arrives in prison, he unexpectedly meets Viral, who comments on how far he has fallen. Meanwhile, the truth about Rossiu`s emergency plan and the consequences for those left behind on Earth are revealed.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: あなたは生き残るべき人だ
title.en: You Must Survive
title.de: Du bist jemand, der überleben sollte
title.fr: Vous devriez être la dernière personne à survivre !
title.it: Tu sei tra le persone che devono sopravvivere

21.overview: The Arc-Gurren escape the Anti-Spiral attack, with only half the number of people they wanted however what awaits them in space is an even greater threat. Meanwhile Yoko has returned from her long absence, to rescue Simon and reunite the Great Gurren Brigade. The peaceful life that she previously led is revealed.
21.summary:
One year earlier, Yoko starts working as a schoolteacher on an island until she learns of the situation at Teppelin and returns to break Simon free. Once again reunited, Simon and the members of Team Dai-Gurren launch themselves into space to protect the Arc-Gurren from the enemy forces, now accompanied by Viral as co-pilot of the Gurren-Lagann.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: それが僕の最後の義務だ
title.en: And to Space
title.de: Dies ist mein letzter Dienst
title.fr: C`est ma dernière responsabilité
title.it: Questo è il mio ultimo dovere
title.x-jat: Sore ga Boku no Saigo no Gimu Da

22.overview: The reunited Great Gurren Brigade have broken through the heavens in order to protect humankind from the Anti-Spiral, however they still have the moon to worry about. When the situation becomes dire the Gurren-Lagann and the Arc-Gurren join together to form the massive Arc-Gurren-Lagann.
22.summary:
The Gurren-Lagann and the Arc-Gurren join together to form the massive Arc-Gurren-Lagann and stop the Human Annihilation System.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 行くぞ 最後の戦いだ
title.en: Let`s Go, The Final Battle
title.de: Vorwärts, dies ist die finale Schlacht
title.fr: En route pour le combat final
title.it: Andiamo! Questa è l`ultima battaglia!

23.overview: One week after preventing the moon's collision the Great Gurren Brigade have a conference to discuss what actions they must take, to ensure humanity's survival. Meanwhile, the depressed Rossiu returns to his old underground village, to think things through. That is when he ends up meeting the old village chief.
23.summary:
The members of Team Dai-Gurren make their preparations for the imminent war against the Anti-Spirals, but Rossiu is missing. However, when Kinon tells Simon about what he really intends to do, both start to look desperately for him.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 忘れるものか この一分一秒を
title.en: We Will Never Forget, This Minute and Second
title.de: Ich vergesse niemals diese Minute, diese Sekunde
title.fr: Je n`oublierai jamais cette minute, cette seconde !
title.it: Non potrò mai dimenticare questo preciso momento!
title.es: Nunca olvidaré este minuto, este segundo
title.ru: Это мгновение будет со мной всегда!
title.pl: Nigdy nie zapomnę tej minuty, tej sekundy
title.x-jat: Wasureru Mono ka Kono Ippun Ichibyou o

24.overview: In order to save the woman Simon loves and the Earth in which his friends resides; the "Super Galactic Great Gurren" was launched, with the Great Gurren Brigade onboard. Guided by Simon and Nia's feelings for each other, the Great Gurren Brigade break through dimensions in search for the Anti-Spirals' homeworld. What can they expect once they arrive to this unknown world?
24.summary:
Guided by Simon and Nia`s feelings for each other, Team Dai-Gurren break through dimensions in search for the Anti-Spirals` homeworld. But after falling into the enemy`s trap, they end up losing some of their most precious members, due to its vicious offensive.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: お前の遺志は受け取った
title.en: I Accept Your Dying Wish!
title.de: Ich akzeptiere deinen letzten Wunsch
title.fr: Que ta dernière volonté soit respectée !
title.it: Sarò io a compiere le tue ultime volontà!

25.overview: Having just lost so many comrades to protect the "Super Galactic Great Gurren", they now find themselves trapped in an ocean of despair. The Great Gurren Brigade struggles to escape from the Death Spiral Field created by the Anti-Spirals, without success. Leeron and the Lord Genome system work together to come up with a way out but who will volunteer for this recklessly suicidal plan?
25.summary:
Team Dai-Gurren struggles to escape from the ocean of despair created by the Anti-Spirals without success, until history repeats itself, as another irreplaceable member of the Team sacrifices himself to save the others.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 行くぜ ダチ公
title.en: Let`s Go, Comrades!
title.de: Vorwärts, Kumpel!
title.fr: En avant camarades !
title.it: Andiamo, compagni!

26.overview: With the sacrifice of one of their important comrades, the Super Galactic Great Gurren is finally able to transform into the "Super Galactic Great Gurren Lagann". Now they stand a fighting chance against the Anti-Spirals. However the enemy then creates an "Alternate Space Labyrinth", to use their own memories and desires against them but an old friend appears to help.
26.summary:
After finally transforming their flagship into the Super Galactic Gurren-Lagann, Simon and his friends successfully fight back against the enemy. When their enemy starts to use their own memories and desires against them, Kamina reappears to help.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 天の光はすべて星
title.en: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
title.de: Die Lichter im Himmel sind Sterne
title.fr: La piste des étoiles
title.it: Tutte le luci in cielo sono stelle
title.es: Las luces en el cielo son estrellas
title.ru: Все эти огни в небе — звёзды...
title.pl: Wszystkie światła na niebie to gwiazdy
title.x-jat: Ten no Hikari wa Subete Hoshi

27.overview:
The members of the Great Gurren Brigade were able to escape the Anti-Spiral's "Alternate Space Labyrinth", and Simon and Nia are reunited at last. By combining the power of  the members, the Great Gurren Brigade creates the "Tengen Toppa Gurren-Lagann", a Gunmen of galactic proportions. 

Be prepared for the most epic battle in the universe. The battle to end all battles begins!
27.summary:
At last, Simon and Nia are reunited, and by combining the power of its members, Team Dai-Gurren creates the galaxy-sized Tengen Toppa Gurren-Lagann, and engage the Anti-Spiral threat in a decisive battle to determine the fate of the universe.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 見てえものは見てえんだ!!
title.en: I`ll See What I Wanna See!!
title.fr: Dans la vie, y`a des occases qu`un mec peut pas rater !

title.en: Episode 15 Storyboards and Partial Animation
